description: Remove the DIRECTORY(ies), if they are empty.

option.name: --ignore-fail-on-non-empty
tip: ignore each failure that is solely because a directory is non-empty

option.name: --parents
tip: remove DIRECTORY and its ancestors; e.g., 'rmdir -p a/b/c' is similar to rmdir a/b/c a/b a

option.name: --verbose
tip: output a diagnostic for every directory processed
